title: Most Frequent Element
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers, find the element that appears most frequently.

If there are multiple elements with the same highest frequency, print the smallest one.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the most frequent element. If there is a tie, print the smallest.
